svg.title: Babul-da rings his bell as the bus wheels enter deeper water.
svg.desc: The bus front wheels sink into muddy water while Babul-da cuts across on his cycle van, ringing his brass bell and directing the driver left. Cecil watches the wheel depth from a raised edge.
svg.text: Page 43, panel 2 · Front three-quarter view of the bus entering the low water

text.tspan: Babul-da rings and signals, but the driver has
already committed to the flooded line.

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
